'''Zsu Val''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All you have to do is go to a guard post outside the walls and attract the udead away from the entrance. Sound like somethin' you can do?|Zsu Val, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FWEC" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Zsu Val was detained in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:FWEC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in the research facility. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref> The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak, including Zsu Val,<ref name="SWG:FWEC" /> were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:Zsu_Val_Camp_Epsilon.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Zsu Val defending Camp Epsilon.]]
The Chiss took shelter in [[Camp Epsilon]], the most unsafe camp since it was located in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, the place where lived the most dangerous undeads.<ref name="SWG:FWEC" /> Other survivors in the camp at that time included the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]],<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref> the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> and the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref> Zsu Val was in charge of the forward defense of the camp and used to recruit spacers who ventured into the Quarantine Zone to help him in that mission.<ref name="SWG:FWEC" />

Later, a group of spacers helped the survivors refugees of camp Camp Epsilon to repair a damaged [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] present in the camp.<ref name="SWG:SP" /> The survivors and the spacers eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone altogether with the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zsu Val was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FWEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zsu Val was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
